title: A service shows no value; the line count opens a hover card
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A schedule open in the editor with a service form ready. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Settings > Maintenance > New schedule (or open a schedule and Edit).
  4. ↳ Click Add service to open the service form.
  5. A service with several canned lines, some absorbed from a covered service.
custom_steps:
1. Look anywhere on the service for a price or estimated time.
  2. Hover the line count and read the card, then move the pointer away.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A service shows no price and no estimated time anywhere in this feature; its hours are the sum of its lines' hours.
  • The line count is not a link and opens nothing; hovering it opens a small-modal card listing the services it covers then its canned lines, one per row, and it closes when the pointer leaves.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10561 (S4, Attach canned lines to a service); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S4; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R6: “A service will invent no prices and estimate no time. Its hours are the sum of its lines' hours, and it shows no value anywhere in this feature”
  • S4-R5: “The line count is not a link and opens nothing. Hovering it opens a card styled as a small modal that lists the services it covers and then its canned lines, one per row, and closes when the pointer leaves”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
